meta.title: Hope For The Nations
meta.description: Faith · Education · Relief — blessing communities with the tools to thrive.

footer.blurb: Blessing communities with the tools to improve their living situation through hope and the Gospel.

home.heroTitle: Blessing communities with the tools to thrive.
home.heroBody: We equip vulnerable children, families, and communities through education, jornadas of outreach, and sustainable programs — rooted in Christian compassion and carried out with local partners around the world.
home.beyondBody: Hope for the Nations began its work in Venezuela. As needs have grown, so has our reach — we now also support jornadas and programs in the United States, with more regions on the horizon as we continue to grow.
home.flagshipBody: Our own online high school, officially registered with the Florida Department of Education, delivering education to students worldwide — the centerpiece of our work today.
home.quote: “Grateful for every hand that showed up this weekend’s jornada in Trujillo. Thank you for making this possible.”

about.title: About Hope for the Nations
about.missionBody: We empower vulnerable children, families, and communities through education, economic opportunity, humanitarian assistance, and sustainable development — partnering with local leaders to build lasting change.
about.visionBody: A world where every child and family, wherever they are, has access to education, opportunity, and spiritual guidance — and where communities thrive with faith, dignity, and resilience.
about.journey2026: School of Hope International officially registered with the Florida Department of Education

team.title: Leadership & Team
team.intro: Behind every student, every family, and every program is a team of passionate individuals committed to making quality education and lasting hope accessible to all. At Hope for the Nations, we believe lasting impact is created when people with different talents come together with one shared purpose: transforming lives through education, compassion, and service.
team.boardBody: Our Board of Directors provides strategic leadership, governance, and accountability to ensure that Hope for the Nations remains faithful to its mission while pursuing sustainable growth and long-term impact.
team.boardComingSoon: Board members will be introduced here soon.
team.schoolBody: School of Hope International is Hope for the Nations' flagship education program — an online high school officially registered with the Florida Department of Education in February 2026. We are currently working toward Cognia accreditation over the next year. The school is led by a dedicated multidisciplinary team in academics, admissions, technology, and communications. More details about that team will be shared on School of Hope International's own site.
team.volunteersBody: Many of our programs are made possible through the dedication of volunteers who generously contribute their time, expertise, and hearts to serve others. Together, we are building opportunities that change lives.
team.cultureIntro: We believe that strong organizations are built on strong values. Everything we do is guided by our commitment to:
team.valueIntegrityBody: We act with honesty, transparency, and accountability.
team.valueCompassionBody: We serve others with empathy and respect.
team.valuePurposeBody: We are driven by a mission greater than ourselves.
team.valueExcellenceBody: We pursue quality in everything we do.
team.valueInnovationBody: We embrace creativity and technology to improve education.
team.valueFaithBody: We believe every person has God-given potential.
team.valueServiceBody: We lead by serving our students, families, and communities.
